titulo_es: We have to do it yes or yes: - -

가지 않으면 안 돼요.es: no hay más remedio que ir, hay que ir sí o sí
가지 않으면 안 돼요.en: There is no choice but to go, to go yes or yes

먹지 않으면 안 돼요.es: hay que comer sí o sí
먹지 않으면 안 돼요.en: You have to eat yes or yes

하지 않으면 안 돼요.es: hay que hacerlo sí o sí
하지 않으면 안 돼요.en: You have to do it yes or yes

약을 먹지 않으면 안 돼요.en: You have to take the medicine.

제출하지 않으면 안 돼요.es: hay que entregarlo sí o sí
제출하지 않으면 안 돼요.en: You have to hand it over, yes or yes.

texto: **-지 않으면 안 되다** comunica que algo es necesario: 가다 → **가지 않으면 안 돼요** (hay que ir), 먹다 → **먹지 않으면 안 돼요** (hay que comer), 하다 → **하지 않으면 안 돼요** (hay que hacerlo). Although it literally has a denial within construction, the global sense is yes: it is necessary to do so.
An obligation is also expressed with **-아/어야 하다** (A2). **-지 않으면 안 되다** can give more emphasis to the need, but the force depends on the context and does not always amount to «yes or yes».
